purpose: cross-check the Rust rusqlite SQLite oracle against the independent Python stdlib sqlite3 oracle for the shapes touched by this gap closure
rusqlite_results_source: temporary in-test capture of rusqlite::Connection (removed after capture; see REVIEW-CORRECTIONS-GAP-CLOSURE-20261111.md)

comparisons.sql: SELECT method_idx,insns_off,insns_size FROM code_items WHERE file_id=0 AND method_idx BETWEEN 0 AND 8 ORDER BY method_idx
SELECT file_id,method AS descriptor FROM method_calls WHERE callee='Lfixture/A;->f()V' ORDER BY file_id,method_idx
SELECT id, value LIKE NULL AS v FROM vals ORDER BY id

note: The Rust test compares the bridge against the bundled rusqlite SQLite for every shape; the Python oracle is the independent second source. NativeV1 intentionally diverges from both oracles for text-to-integer CAST; the test asserts that divergence (INVALID_INTEGER_CAST) while legacy dialects match the oracle value.
